description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+, including Jakarta EE namespace migration.
tasks.reason: Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 are end-of-life per Acme Corp internal policy. The playbook mandates Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+ as targets for all Java supply chain services. Spring Boot 2.x and 3.x must be upgraded.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.0+ and Java from 8 to 25. Migrate all JavaEE namespace references from javax.* to jakarta.* as required by Spring Boot 4.0+. Align all dependency versions for Spring Boot 4.0+ and Java 25 compatibility. Ensure the project builds and all existing tests pass after the upgrade. Build and runtime base images should use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless respectively.

tasks.description: Validate and fix all CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies.
tasks.reason: User requires all CVE issues to be identified and resolved to ensure the application is free of known security vulnerabilities after the upgrade.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities. Fix all identified critical and high-severity CVEs. Ensure the project builds successfully and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Update the Dockerfile for Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.0+ and prepare for Azure Container Apps deployment.
tasks.reason: The current Dockerfile uses Java 8 and Tomcat 8.5 base images which are incompatible with the upgraded runtime. The Dockerfile must be updated to use Acme Corp approved base images for ACA deployment.
tasks.requirements: Update the Dockerfile to use the approved base images (mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu for build, mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless for runtime). Ensure the containerized application is compatible with Azure Container Apps.

tasks.description: Deploy the containerized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The Acme Corp modernization strategy mandates replatforming all Java supply chain services to Azure Container Apps as the default compute platform.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the application to Azure Container Apps. Configure the ACA environment with appropriate resource settings for the frontend application.
tasks.resourceStatus: Create new Azure Container Apps resource
